verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own sandbox environment for simulating transactions before going live. That is a separate pre-production environment, so testing does not touch live data. The evidence is a single short docs line, though, and gives no detail on how the sandbox is isolated or what it covers. missing for 10: detailed docs on separate sandbox credentials and endpoints and on isolation from production data, which API products and flows the sandbox supports, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Use Airwallex's sandbox environment to simulate transactions before going live
